description: Fetch one absolute URL with AgentSearch Web Extract and return it as JSON text: title, clean markdown and/or text, links, meta (status_code, content_type, fetched_at, chars, truncated) and error (null on success). Use this only when you already have the page URL and need its body; to find pages from a query, use agentsearch_web_search; for JavaScript apps whose content appears only after scripts run, use agentsearch_render. Default mode: calls the Pocket Network Agentic Portal and PAYS $0.005 in USDC on Base per call over x402 from the wallet in AGENTSEARCH_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY (or POCKET_PRIVATE_KEY), never more than $0.005 per call and never more than AGENTSEARCH_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC per session (default $1.00); the result includes the payment receipt and the portal envelope {portal, data}, whose data is untrusted third-party content. If AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL is set, calls your self-hosted AgentSearch API instead (no payment). With neither set (no config), agentsearch_web_search uses the free AgentSearch relay (https://relay.agentsearchhq.com, 25 searches per day per user, no payment), while agentsearch_extract and agentsearch_render make no network call and explain how to add a wallet. Note: the free relay serves search only; this tool needs paid mode (AGENTSEARCH_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY) or a self-hosted API. Read-only: not destructive, but it fetches over the network and can hit rate limits.

formats.description: Renderings to return: "markdown" and/or "text" (default: the service's choice).

max_chars.description: Cap on returned characters (1–100000, service default 50000).

url.description: Absolute URL of the page to extract.
